Name: (CP) More Bar Transmutations
Author: pancham138
Description:
Do you have a bunch of Iridium Bars unused in your late game and you need a bunch of Gold Bars, Iron Bars and Copper Bars instead but too lazy for grinding them? Then this mod is for you!

This mod added more transmutations for bars as mentioned below
[list]
[*]Transmute Back (Cu)
[/list] ﻿Unlocked at Mining skill level 4. Transmute 1 Iron Bar to 3 Copper Bar. [list]
[*]Transmute Back (Fe)
[/list] ﻿Unlocked at Mining skill level 7. ﻿Transmute 1 Gold Bar to 2 Iron Bar .
[list]
[*]Transmute (Ir)
[/list] ﻿Unlocked at Mining skill level 9. Transmute 4 Gold Bar to 1 Iridium Bar.
[list]
[*]Transmute Back (Au)
[/list] ﻿Unlocked at Mining skill level 9. Transmute 1 Iridium Bar to 4 Gold Bar.
[list]
[*]Transmute (Rad)
[/list] ﻿Unlocked at Mining skill level 9. Transmute 3 Iridium Bar to 1 Radioactive Bar
[list]
[*]Transmute Back (Ir)
[/list] ﻿Unlocked at Mining skill level 9. Transmute 1 Radioactive Bar to 3 Iridium Bar﻿

Notes:
[list]
[*]In multiplayer, both host and client need to install this mod, otherwise only the player who installed the mod can use the crafting recipes.
[*]You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ mod with at least [b]version 1.14.0[/b] for this mod to work.
[*]If this mod not working for you, please check [b]which version of Content Patcher[/b] are you using.
[*]Download the [b]version 0.1.0[/b] instead if you need it to work with [b]Content Patcher version 1.13.0[/b]. Check the Old Files section to download it.
[/list]
Which version?
[list]
[*]1.2.0 for Content Patcher 1.19.0 or later, and SMAPI 3.8.0 or later.
[*]1.1.1 for Content Patcher 1.14.0 or later.
[/list]
Configuration:
[list]
[*][b]EnableIridiumTransmutations[/b] : "true" or "false" | default to "true"
[/list] ﻿Set this to "false" if you want to disable the Iridium Bar transmutations which means you will not be able to transmute Gold Bars to Iridium Bar, and Iridium Bar to Gold Bars.
[list]
[*][b]EnableRadioactiveTransmutations[/b] : "true" or "false" | default to "true"
[/list] ﻿Set this to "false" if you want to disable the Radioactive Bar transmutations which means you will not be able to transmute Iridium Bars to Radioactive Bar, and Radioactive Bar to Iridium Bars.
[list]
[*][b]GoldBarRequiredForIridium[/b] : [i]2, 3, 4, 5[/i] | default to "4"
[*][b]IridiumBarRequiredForRadioactive[/b] : [i]2, 3, 4, 5[/i] | default to "3"
[/list]
Supported Translations:
[list]
[*]English
[*]French
[/list]
